The identity-attribution experiment is commissioned: arms A, B, D and C on the frozen v2 population, under the joint proposal and addenda on this epic (ops 20261025T140608.260924Z-p10810-c0000-rca0d-hddbbcf, 20261025T140809.851661Z-p16321-c0000-rec89-h9ebf19, 20261025T144732.050282Z-p39096-c0000-r1211-h23b326, 20261025T145833.208932Z-p74333-c0000-rc31c-h8d8ede and Codex's acknowledgements).
2. The qualified human reference reviewer: the owner asked how long the review takes, which implies the owner reviews. Confirmation is pending in chat.
3. ADR 0027 decision 1 is extended: Name - All counts as human-reviewed presence beyond rows 500-585, for the selected v2 blocks. This needs a docs amendment to ADR 0027.
4. Spend for arm C (direct multimodal judgment) is approved. A concrete bound is to be stated before any call. The existing epic constraint, no new paid model runs before S0/S1 land, still applies unless the owner lifts it; S0/S1 sit in integration candidate f09066772 (bd-01M5RAN674YW0QGQFM7RY66WXM).
